An OVERLAY on the driver baked into the coach, not a body sprite. Only 55% of him separates from the coach -- below 27% of the assembly he is fused into the seat, footboard and reins -- so the head swaps and the body holds, the same shape as Thad's talk.

All three share an identical 786x1140 canvas. neutral vs speaking differs on 1,240px confined to the mouth, rows 36-48%. neutral vs looking-down differs on 68,573px, of which 66,371 are the head and hat and only 2,202 the shoulders and coat -- the coat shifting where the neck meets it, which is what a lowered chin actually does.

THE FIRST looking-down ATTEMPT FAILED and the fix is general: it came from a three-up sheet and came back 884x1114, differing on 116,784px across the whole figure. Regenerated by attaching the EXTRACTED NEUTRAL HEAD on its own canvas instead of the sheet. One figure at a fixed canvas size gives the generator something exact to match -- the same thing that made Thad's talk frames land first try.
